newsitem.title: CANADA: BASEBALL-O'NEILL NAMED TO REPLACE FRANK THOMAS IN ALL-STAR GAME.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-O'NEILL NAMED TO REPLACE FRANK THOMAS IN ALL-STAR GAME.

text.p: New York Yankees manager Joe Torre on Saturday named one of his outfielders, Paul O'Neill, to replace Chicago White Sox first baseman Frank Thomas for Tuesday's All-Star game at Cleveland.
Thomas declined his invitation to the All-Star game in order to rest his sore rib cage.
"The bottom line is that I'm not 100 percent," said Thomas after he had two hits in Chicago's 6-5 win over the Red Sox on Friday. Thomas homered in Saturday's 11-8 victory over Boston.
Torre opted to reward O'Neill rather than name another prominent first baseman, such as Cleveland's Jim Thome or Detroit's Tony Clark, to replace Thomas.
Thome is batting .296 with 23 home runs and 61 RBI, while Clark is hitting .290 with 21 homers and 71 RBI.

O'Neill, who is batting .313 with 11 homers and 54 RBI, is the fifth Yankee on the American League All-Star team, joining first baseman Tino Martinez, outfielder Bernie Williams and pitchers David Cone and Mariano Rivera.
Thomas, the second-leading hitter in the American League, missed 13 games in June with a strained rib cage muscle. He is batting .370 with 17 homers and 61 RBI this season.
